new_jobs.description:
Posting End Date

September 16, 2026

Employee Type

Regular-Full time

Union/Non

This is a non-union position

Are you a Senior Project Manager who enjoys leading a multi-disciplinary team passionate about interconnection projects?

In this role, you will lead and plan the execution of multiple measurement and regulation projects to fulfil interconnection agreements across the gas transportation system. You will be responsible for managing project scope, cost, and schedule through effective risk management, and will be expected to safely deliver high-quality facilities installations. Apply today!

What You Will Do

Own end-to-end project delivery: Develop cost estimates, schedules, and proposals while managing scope, budget, risk, and governance across the project lifecycle.
Drive project controls & performance: Track costs, forecasts, invoices, and change orders while monitoring schedule and budget risks.
Manage procurement & contracts: Lead RFPs, negotiate terms, issue work orders, and ensure Supply Chain alignment.
Coordinate construction & stakeholders: Lead meetings, align contractors and teams, track progress, and implement corrective actions.
Enable continuous improvement & standards: Apply lessons learned, enhance engineering standards, and promote consistent processes across the organization.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree, diploma or certification from a recognized university or college.
6 or more years of progressively detailed design and/or project management and/or field engineering/management experience. General understanding of pipeline and terminal operations. Without a degree, 9 years of experience is required.
Demonstrated technical competence in at least one of the engineering fields with knowledge of others, in addition have exposure to construction and field operations.
Problem solving, decision-making, organization, planning, and leadership skills.
Effective interpersonal skills to work in a collaborative, team- and customer-focused work environment.
Role requires a valid driver’s license, which will be verified with a motor vehicle check prior to hire.

Working Conditions

Office environment with some field work required.
Scheduled travel to operating facilities, construction sites, and manufacturer’s facilities (up to 25%).

Physical Requirements Include But Are Not Limited To

Grasping, kneeling, light – moderate lifting (objects up to 20 pounds), reaching above shoulder, repetitive motion, typing, sitting, standing, visual requirement (able to see screens, detect color coding, read fine print), hearing requirement and the ability to sit at a computer for long periods of time.

Mental Requirements (Both Field & Office) include but are not limited to:

Ability to: understand, remember and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information, understand complex problems and collaborate/explore alternative solutions, organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology, organize and prioritize work schedule on a short-term basis, make decisions which have moderate impact on the immediate work unit and monitor impact outside this area, understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines, complete routine forms, compose letters, outlines, memoranda and basic reports and communicate with individuals via telephone.

Salary

Ranges from $96,200 - $140,000/year USD for US locations based upon candidate’s experience, skills, and internal equity.
Applicable compensation policies and guidelines apply to internal candidates.

Benefits

A flexible benefits program that allows each employee to select the level of coverage needed for their family in the areas of health, dental, insurance, and disability.
A paid maternity and parental leave benefit that offers up to 20 weeks of paid leave for birth-giving parents and up to 12 weeks for other eligible parents, providing flexibility and support during this important life event.
Valuable retirement savings plans, including a savings plan with company stock as an investment option.
Paid time off/vacation/sick, plus paid personal days off (depending on location), and paid holidays.
An Employee and Family Assistance Program.
A Wellness Program, which focuses on supporting healthier employees by providing tools, resources, and opportunities to improve physical, mental, social, and financial well-being.
Enbridge’s FlexWork (hybrid work model) offers eligible employees (Manager and below) the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays, opt for a compressed work week schedule, or have flexible start and end times. Role requirements determine your eligibility for each option.

At Enbridge, we are dedicated to our core value of Inclusion. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, veteran status, Indigenous status, disability, or any other reason protected by federal, state, or local law. Applicants with disabilities can request accessible formats, communication supports, or other accessibility assistance by contacting careers@enbridge.com.

Information For Applicants

Applications can be submitted via our online recruiting system only.
We appreciate your interest in working with us; however, only those applicants selected for interviews will be contacted.
Final candidates for this position may be required to undergo a security screening, including a criminal records check.

To learn more about us, visit www.enbridge.com

new_jobs.title: Project Manager/Estimator Fresno CA
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Certerra is a growing national provider of testing, inspection, and certification services that support innovation in new product development, quality assurance, for project delivery, and engineered solutions for asset management. We are passionate about contributing to the sustainable development of the communities we serve. We are a national firm with a global reach serving national and international clients from 30+ offices located in 10 states and are ranked on ENR’s Top 500 list alongside the nation’s top firms. With a 60-year history, Certerra has a passion for high-end services, constant innovation, and investment in the development of world-class laboratory facilities, and interactive management technologies. Each member of our staff is committed to service, innovation, and the success of our clients.

Certerra is a consulting firm with over 65 years of quality service that offers professional services in the southwestern United States in the fields of geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering, construction materials engineering and testing, nondestructive testing, and welding inspection.

Certerra office located in Fresno, CA is seeking qualified Project Manager/ Estimator to join our team of great civil engineer services, this opportunity provides a great stepping stone into management roles with great career paths.

Position Title

Project Manager/Estimator:

Plans and manages multiple projects assigned by the Senior Project Manager and may include interoffice projects on a larger, more complicated scale.
Provide leadership, mentoring and training of other staff
Offers technical guidance, reviews progress and advises procedural changes if required. Provide technical assistance as requested by team.
Provide project management for the entire project. Conduct coordination meetings with each client.
Perform site visits/ field calculations to compensate for change orders, contract estimates to prepare computations and proposals.
Plans alterations and modifications to improve final product.
Receive communications from clients and respond promptly and professionally
Use computer programs to illustrate project specifications. Estimates costs and work schedules.
Prepares budgets, contracts, and other related financial matters bearing on assigned projects, administers the contracts and controls budgets.
Primarily responsible for profit and loss on all assigned projects.
Prepare monthly billings and progress reports for assigned projects.
Assists with the preparation of proposals. Prepares and presents public reports of analysis, information, technical qualifications and approach at community forums or selection interviews.
Review and analyze structural and civil plans
Communicate with team members about upcoming deadlines and specific responsibilities
Attend technical seminars and conferences to increase technical expertise and for marketing purposes.
Performs related duties, special assignments and projects as required and assigned by the Senior Project Management or designee.
Track and log opportunities across multiple databases
Use Salesforce for project and client tracking and analysis

Requirements

Education:

Bachelor of Science degree or equivalent experience .

Experience

Must have a minimum of 5 years project management / estimating responsibilities and experience (construction materials testing and special inspection related experience preferred) , including general computer expertise. Strong organizational skills along with excellent oral and written communication ability.

Certifications Preferred (but Not Required)

UDOT, ACI, WAQTC, NICET Level III, and/or ICC certifications in:

Field Testing

Soils / Aggregate Testing

Asphalt Concrete Testing

Masonry Testing

Fireproofing

Physical And Other Requirements

Primarily works in a standard office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk and listen. The employee is occasionally required to walk; use hands and fingers to feel, handle, or operate objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus in order to read hand printed materials as well as computer documents. Operation of the following is required: telephone, personal computer including word processing software, and copy machine. Current valid driver's license. Ability to travel by automobile around the state as needed

EOC Statement

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This Company is dedicated to both the letter and the spirit of the equal opportunity employment laws. All applicants and all employees will be evaluated on the basis of their ability, competence, and performance of the essential functions of their positions. There will be no discrimination on the basis of race, sex, national origin, religion, age 40 and over, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other classification which may be protected by federal, state, or local laws. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we specifically offer equal opportunity for all employees or job applicants who may have a physical or mental disability. Such persons will be hired on the basis of their ability to perform the essential functions of the job in question. Likewise, their work will be evaluated on their performance of these essential functions. new_jobs.title: Engineering Project Manager - Renewables
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

If you are a Project Management
professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. Based in our Cranberry Township, PA
office, you will lead and manage the full lifecycle of renewable energy projects across hydro, solar, battery, and wind applications.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and customers to deliver innovative solutions that help power generation facilities operate at peak performance. From project planning and procurement through commissioning, closeout, and warranty support, you will play a key role in driving successful project outcomes while contributing to the growth of Emerson's renewable energy business.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, resource allocations, and budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
Establish clear project expectations and work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to achieve project goals.
Coordinate and oversee the activities of engineering, electrical, mechanical, and specialty subcontractors.
Manage project documentation, including contracts, change orders, proposals, correspondence, compliance records, and project archives.
Identify, assess, and manage project risks while collaborating with technical teams to develop effective mitigation strategies.
Anticipate and address scope changes, facilitating productive discussions and negotiations to support project success.
Build strong customer and stakeholder relationships through proactive communication and responsiveness.
Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining a high standard of quality and execution.
Lead pre-bid meetings, site visits, project kickoff meetings, and project review sessions.
Partner with Sales and other business teams to support proposal development and guide opportunities through the bidding process.
Share lessons learned and provide recommendations that continuously improve project execution practices.

Who You Are:

You anticipate customer needs and provide services that are beyond customer expectations. You lay out a thorough schedule and list steps for achieving objectives. You actively listen and check for understanding.

For This Role, You Will Need:

Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Business, other technical discipline or equivalent
3+ years of technical project management experience
Strong autonomous work ethic combined with self-directed leadership skills
Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment
Excellent organizational and planning skills
Comprehensive understanding of standard proposal development tools and processes
Able to travel up to 20%
Legal authorization to work in the United States – sponsorship will not be provided for this position.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Experience with Control Systems or Power generation industry

Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

Learn more about our Culture & Values .

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Work Authorization

Emerson will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1(including those with OPT or CPT) , H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Emerson is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

About Emerson

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

No calls or agencies please.

At Siemens Digital Industries Software
, you have an opportunity to help drive the successful on-boarding and integration of newly acquired employees into a globally distributed organization. You will work closely with many talented Siemens colleagues from around the world – Global and Country P&O functions, Corporate M&A, Finance, IT, Compliance, Legal, Facilities, Procurement – and work closely with the acquired company leaders and integration team members. This role entails the full breadth of the M&A lifecycle from due diligence through all stages of integration planning and execution. The role will be based is in the United States.

Reporting to the P&O Director, M&A for Digital Industries Software, globally lead cross functional project planning and execution for assigned M&A projects with a focus on US based acquisitions and integrations.
Develop end-to-end integration project plans, workstream charters, weekly updates, project templates and documentation, audit requirements and Town Hall presentations/employee communications.

Partner closely with global P&O Business Partners and Country P&O Managers on retention plans for key employees, job mapping, compensation benchmarking & alignment, benefits alignment/harmonization, organization structure, employment contracts and policies.
Leads P&O project meetings and coaches and guides P&O project team members throughout the life cycle of the project.
Establish a high level of collaboration and alignment with HRIS/Operations/Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Immigration, L&D, etc. on P&O integration concept and planning activities.

Deliver against defined project milestones ensuring integration of all P&O processes, policies and technology including but not limited to payroll, HR data management, total rewards, talent acquisition, talent management, employment policies and compliance, employee surveys
Provide oversight and direction on the communications and change management strategy and employee engagement plan development.
Participate in global P&O projects on an ad hoc basis.

Bachelor’s Degree’s is required

10+ years of experience in a variety of Human Resources/People & Organization roles for a large multi-national company.
7+ years of experience in a HR/P&O business partner role preferably with multi-country experience supporting global employee populations and also integrating newly acquired employees into business functions (job mapping, compensation alignment, talent assessment, organization structures, etc).
5+ years of experience supporting US-based new hire onboarding activities with strong knowledge of US employment laws and company employment policies.
Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines including benefits, compensation, payroll, talent management, talent acquisition, employment law and compliance.
Process oriented and data-driven, with the motivation and skills to improve workflows across many interdependent functions.

Ability to work autonomously and make thoughtful decisions quickly.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint, and HR systems and tools.
Scheduling flexibility is needed to work across multiple time zones to accommodate meeting schedules.
Ability to travel domestically in the US and occasionally for meetings in other countries

Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Strategic Customers Engineering organization within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) sits at the center of the fastest-growing and most technically demanding part of the cloud: building at scale for the world’s leading AI innovators. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager who thrives in complexity, moves with urgency, and brings people together to deliver outcomes that matter. This is a role for someone who doesn’t just track work but drives it. Someone who brings clarity where there is ambiguity, momentum where there is friction, and alignment where there are competing priorities.

Candidate Profile:

10+ years’ experience developing and implementing strategy, then executing against, large cross cutting programs.
You display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically.
You possess a technology background that enables you to understand the complexities of cloud architecture.
You possess and exemplify maturity, judgment, negotiation/influence skills, analytical skills, and leadership skills.
You can work well with senior leaders within all of Oracle (from engineering to business) to drive results for core business initiatives.
You work well in ambiguity, can work with your team to dive into a problem and create a solution.
Knowledge of Data Center GPU architecture and operations.
Familiarity and knowledge of AI workloads and Software stack.
Experience in a customer facing role in a tech company. Experience with AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) customers is a big plus.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Drives rapid response to security escalations, coordinating across teams and communicating to executives to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and align and execute optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.

– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

– Develops delivery standards and guidelines in alignment with Oracle best practices.

– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.

– Contributes to incident management efforts and identifies opportunities to improve processes, as applicable.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones for each program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.

– Assists in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).

– Builds, maintains, and executes a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers, influencing decision-making regarding best practices for Oracle systems.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success) while providing technical support and direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Maintains comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and documents risks and issues.

– Ensures attention to detail in program management from planning to execution and reporting.

– Leads regular program status meetings and keeps teams and leadership informed.

– Leads initiatives within the team to improve operational efficiency and enhance adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.

– Ensures ownership and accountability for forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Guides the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate.

– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Leads program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes.

– Organizes and develops program objectives and workflows, while testing and deploying cross-functional solutions to address critical business problems.

– Collaborates with management to initiate and maintain processes and procedures that guide and assist teams in reaching their goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.

– Develops and standardizes data-driven decision-making frameworks, ensuring insights drive efficiencies.

– Identifies and addresses gaps to facilitate business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving discussions that align priorities and program goals.

– Leads medium-scale efforts to optimize processes, identifying and implementing solutions that enhance team efficiency.

– Delivers program updates, risks, and opportunities to managers and leadership, influencing decision-making.

– Develops relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their perspectives are integrated into program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Leads programs to continuously improve organizational efficiency.

– Provides technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Influences and guides change at all levels of the group from initiation through delivery.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage program execution.

– Utilizes data to solve moderately complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

, you will lead the governance and delivery assurance of a complex AI-ready data platform and enterprise-wide data migration programme on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for a major telecommunications environment. You will bring together programme management and strong technical understanding of data architecture, engineering, cloud-native platforms, and data governance to coordinate delivery across customer, partner, and technical teams.

Program Governance & Execution

Lead execution and delivery assurance across complex, multi-workstream data programmes.
Maintain the programme schedule, manage risk and issue registers, and ensure dependencies and delivery priorities remain visible and actively managed.
Provide regular weekly Project Status Reports and clear programme updates to steering committees.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary liaison between Google Professional Services, channel partners, and the customer's project manager and technical SMEs.
Coordinate customer-side dependencies, including landing zone readiness and secure data extraction, to support programme delivery.
Maintain effective alignment across business, programme, and technical stakeholders throughout implementation.

Data Architecture & Implementation Coordination

Partner with customer engineering leads and Google technical teams to oversee implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Terraform modules for GCP data services.
Coordinate deployment across technologies including Apache Iceberg on GCS, Dataproc Serverless, Cloud Composer, Looker, and Analytics Hub.
Ensure technical implementation activities remain aligned with programme objectives, dependencies, and delivery requirements.

Technical Workshop Facilitation

Lead joint technical workshops to define Data Mesh topologies, data product taxonomies, metadata harvesting strategies, and semantic layer integration.
Facilitate alignment with enterprise catalogues and platforms including Knowledge Catalog, DataHub, and Dataplex.

Validation & Handover

Manage validation and deployment of blueprint data pipelines, including use cases such as IPDR demand trend analysis.
Oversee the data flow from raw ingestion through Apache NiFi to GCS and BigQuery, ensuring the target-state environment is operational and enabled with BigQuery ML.
Coordinate validation and handover activities to support successful transition of the target-state data platform.

Cross Technology Alignment

Facilitate cross-technology alignment across remote delivery teams and adjacent domains, including Infrastructure, Data, and Security.
Ensure dependencies and technical considerations across workstreams are identified and coordinated throughout delivery.

We'd Love to Hear From You If...

Experience

You have 10+ years of experience managing complex data transformation programmes, including at least 3 to 5 years specifically focused on large-scale data migrations on GCP.
You have proven experience delivering data programmes involving multiple technical workstreams and stakeholders.
Telecommunications industry experience is preferred, particularly involving high-volume telemetry datasets such as IP Detail Records.
A Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

Technical Expertise

You have strong working knowledge of cloud-native data architectures, batch and streaming data pipelines, and cloud analytics services including BigQuery, Dataplex, Dataproc, and Cloud Composer.
You understand domain-driven Data Mesh architectures, Data Contracts, lakehouse storage formats, particularly Apache Iceberg, and federated computational governance.
You have experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and enterprise cloud security frameworks, including VPC-SC, IAM policy-driven access models, and data masking tools.
Experience with high-volume data ingestion using open-source technologies such as Apache NiFi or Kafka is preferred.
You can work effectively across GCP data and analytics technologies including GCS, BigQuery, BigQuery ML, Looker, Analytics Hub, and enterprise catalogue environments.

Ways of Working

You can operate effectively between programme governance and complex technical delivery, translating technical dependencies, risks, and progress into clear programme actions.
You are confident facilitating technical workshops and coordinating customer engineering teams, technical SMEs, partners, and remote delivery teams.
You can maintain alignment across Infrastructure, Data, Security, and other adjacent technology domains while managing multiple programme dependencies.

Location: Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines
Work Setup: Hybrid
Contract Duration: 12 months

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

BAE Systems is seeking an exceptional Acquisition Project Manager for an exciting opportunity to support the Air Force's acquisition of Sentinel, the nation’s next generation Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM).

Why BAE Systems? BAE Systems is the third largest defense contractor in the world known for our exceptional, mission-focused culture. The 800+ BAE Systems employees and sub-contractors located at Hill Air Force Base, Utah, are closely aligned to the U.S. Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC). We support the Center in sustaining the existing LGM-30 Minuteman III (MMIII) weapon system and acquiring its replacement, LGM-35A Sentinel (formerly known as the Ground-Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD)). We are a uniquely-valued mission partner delivering daily technical excellence and innovative solutions to our government customer. For the sixth consecutive year, BAE was named among the Salt Lake Tribune's 2023 "Top Workplaces," by its employees, earning special distinction for providing a healthy work-life balance for our valued employees. We work very hard to ensure this is a great place to work!

Why Utah? You’ve got to see it to believe it! Utah is an amazing state with diverse geography, an eclectic culture and an exceptional quality of life. We are located north of Salt Lake City at the foot of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. The area offers an incredible range of outdoors pursuits across the seasons including hiking, climbing, hunting, fishing, camping, boating and world-class skiing at resorts that hosted the 2002 Winter Olympics. The state is home to five amazing National Parks and an easy drive from two more—Teton National Park and Yellowstone, famously, the first national park in the world. The Salt Lake City area offers a vast array of cultural activities and businesses including multiple professional sports teams. It is a western states hub for exceptional, cutting-edge medical care with people traveling from across the region for a range of nationally renowned specialty care centers and doctors. The Salt Lake City International Airport is expanding and offers easy, direct access to just about anywhere you want to fly.

Why SENTINEL? There is never a dull moment on this strategic effort, a cornerstone for the nation’s security! The Sentinel Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Program will completely replace the aging Minuteman III (MMIII) ICBM, an undertaking not performed in over 50 years. This program is considered a “mega-project” and one of the most complex in the history of the Department of Defense. The new ICBM weapon system acquisition effort brings with it the newest digital engineering tools and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices to meet existing warfighter requirements, while having the adaptability and flexibility to affordably address changing technology and threat environments through 2075. As part of the U.S. Air Force's Integration Support Contract (ISC), BAE Systems provides advisory and assistance services in the areas of engineering, logistics, management, scientific analysis, and other subject matter expertise to augment and optimize management of the Sentinel ICBM Prime Contractor.

Tell me about this job. BAE is looking for an experienced Logistics Professional accountable to the Product Support Branch lead for all tasks assigned for Sentinel Product Support. Candidate will serve as a non-supervisory Acquisition Logistician and work with a highly skilled team providing mission-critical acquisition project management, reporting, and program integration functions on behalf of the Sentinel System Program Office. Candidate will serve as an acquisition logistics subject matter expert, key program advisor, and a focal point for the assessment and reporting of Sentinel program status, including technical performance, contract performance, enterprise integrated master schedule health, and risks, issues, and opportunities. Candidate will operate in an organizational culture that develops and challenges employees to achieve high performance in a fast-paced, high-morale workplace using streamlined management policies and procedures. Specifically, this Product Support team member will be responsible for working with Air Force stakeholders for the evaluation and integration of various integrated product support elements including Maintenance Planning and Management, Depot Maintenance, Support Equipment, and other Integrated Product Support elements as required by the integrated product teams. Additionally, this role will identify specific Logistics processes, key stakeholders and schedule to support the programs cross functional activities and resulting product support package. This is a dynamic and rewarding opportunity to shape the development and deployment of the next generation intercontinental ballistic missile—the national security critical backbone of our nuclear deterrent capability. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing team within a large defense company known for our extraordinary, positive culture and mission focus. In this position, you will provide direct support to a national security-critical weapon system throughout engineering development, deployment, and sustainment. You will help shape the quality and performance of program management products from across the directorate and functional areas, and you will help educate and equip the government customer to acquire, operate, and maintain an entire weapon system-of-systems. You will become a trusted mission partner to the innovative, digital engineering-driven Air Force organization that is responsible to design, build, test, transition, and sustain the world’s safest, most secure, and effective land-based nuclear deterrent, on-schedule. Ultimately, this is a dynamic and rewarding opportunity to shape the development and deployment of the next generation intercontinental ballistic missile. Do not miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

Pursuant to Government contract, this position requires U.S. citizenship status.

Join an extraordinary company culture and the winning team to success this year and for years to come.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

7 yrs of progressive technical experience
Experience on an Acquisition Category (ACAT) I level program or similar
Demonstrated comfort and capabilities working under stressful conditions, aggressive schedules, variable workloads, and shifting priorities
Risk management experience; demonstrated management experience evaluating and mitigating risk at the program or enterprise level
Possesses excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience in managing program cost, schedule, and/or performance
Must have a current Secret security clearance or higher (adjudicated within the past 6 years) and be eligible to obtain and maintain all required Special Program accesses

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

Experience at a System Program Office (or higher-level staff) executing/overseeing program(s) in the Engineering and Manufacturing Development (EMD) or similar acquisition program phase
Understanding of integration across multiple areas of an ACAT I level program
Understanding of Control Account Management responsibilities
Understanding of Earned Value Management
Exceptional customer engagement, writing, and communication skills
Experience creating presentation content for executive level meetings and conducting senior level meetings
ICBM weapon system and/or program support experience

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Intelligence & Security

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit's CTREC organization (Cybersecurity, Trust & Safety, Risk, Enterprise Systems and Compliance) protects the company and powers the technology experiences of our global workforce. We're looking for a Senior Change Manager to own organizational change management (OCM) delivery and adoption strategy for CTREC's most critical programs — the changes that touch every Intuit employee, from security protocols to enterprise systems to employee-experience technology.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not an advisory one. You will craft the change strategy for each program and personally execute every piece of it — communications across channels, enablement content, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement. There is no separate design or communications team behind you, and no runway to learn the discipline on the job. Skilled, self-directed OCM leadership is essential to adoption success from day one.

You'll operate as part of the Change COE — the team that designs the human layer around technology change so employees don't just get access to something new; they understand it, want it, and can use it well. The COE matches its response to the size and risk of each change: it Drives the highest-impact changes end to end, Supports moderate ones by contributing strategy while the owning team executes, and Consults as the fast expert check on lower-risk changes. You'll flex across all three modes and partner with the OCM lead to define the engagement model and tiered level of support for each initiative.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end OCM delivery and adoption strategy for critical CTREC programs — from impact assessment through launch, adoption, and reinforcement.
Build change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end yourself: audience and impact analysis, adoption plans, success metrics, and risk mitigation — with no reliance on separate design or communications resources.
Develop and deliver communications for multiple channels (email, Slack, intranet, in-tool messaging, executive briefings), right-sized to audience and moment.
Create enablement content — guides, FAQs, training assets, self-service resources — that helps a distributed global workforce understand, embrace, and adopt change.
Drive stakeholder engagement across all levels, from frontline employees to senior leadership, building the coalitions each change needs to land.
Partner closely with Development, the Product lead, and the Technical Program Manager as an embedded member of the program team, and align strategy with the OCM lead.
Flex across the Change COE's engagement tiers — Drive, Support, or Consult — matching depth of involvement to the size and risk of each change, and partner with the OCM lead to define engagement models and tiered levels of support across the portfolio.
Invent creative, low-friction adoption solutions — resourceful ways to reach and activate distributed audiences and build trust in automation that acts on a user's behalf.
Develop and implement change management tools and processes that accelerate change activities, ensure a consistent change experience, and standardize communication approaches across programs.
Monitor employee feedback channels to address questions and gauge sentiment on Security change initiatives, feeding insights back into program decisions.
Measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate — closing the loop between user sentiment and program decisions.

Qualifications

7+ years of change management experience supporting large, multi-site enterprise implementations of HR, IT service, Security, or employee-experience technology.
Proven ability to own change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end personally — you are the strategist, writer, designer, and facilitator in one.
A track record of creative, low-friction adoption solutions that reached and activated distributed audiences — including building user trust in automation acting on their behalf.
AI platform fluency — you use AI tools and platforms fluently in your own work (research, content development, analysis) and can guide others through AI-driven change.
Excellent writing and content-design skills across formats and channels, with the judgment to right-size comms to the change.
Strong stakeholder management — comfortable partnering with engineering, product, and program leaders and influencing without authority.
Self-direction and speed: you scope ambiguity into a plan, prioritize independently, and deliver without needing the role explained to you.
Strong proficiency applying ADKAR or an equivalent structured change methodology within condensed go-live timelines and high stakeholder expectations.
Proven ability to manage concurrent workloads under a fixed deadline, sequencing communications across phased waves to prevent audience fatigue and message conflicts.
Strong executive communication skills — comfortable drafting on behalf of senior HR and technology leadership for enterprise-wide distribution.
Domain experience across collaboration SaaS applications, HR, and Security, with a working understanding of data security and compliance concepts.
Skilled in impact analysis, stakeholder mapping, and developing communication and care/readiness plans.
Technology company experience implementing change efforts that impact technologist/development organizations as well as business functions.
Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to achieve business goals.

Who You Are

Customer obsessed — inspired by the customer problem, partnering with process owners to drive change, education, and outreach.
A strong process and systems thinker, sees how changes, channels, and audiences interact across a portfolio, and builds repeatable tools, standards, and mechanisms rather than one-off fixes.
Demonstrates extreme ownership, delivers excellence at scale, and operates without boundaries.
Influences and drives decisions by crafting a clear point of view — options, data-backed recommendations, and rationale — and builds a compelling, data-backed case for change.
Proactively identifies obstacles, develops recommendations for resolution, and escalates to leaders quickly.
Quickly establishes credibility and trust across teams; leads with inquiry and incorporates diverse perspectives to deliver high-impact outcomes.
Resilient and solution-oriented in a high-change, often ambiguous environment, with a data-led and data-driven approach focused on long-term opportunity.
Proactive, action-oriented self-starter with high judgment, innovation, and strategic thinking; strong organizational and time-management skills.
Works independently and collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams and with employees at all levels, using inquiry and advocacy to work through barriers.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Mountain View $158,000 - $214,000

Build and automate financial reports, reconciliations, and analyses using SQL in Snowflake and reporting tools such as Tableau and Sigma.

🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin?

Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network , se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?

🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?

En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol

Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento
de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable?
¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades

Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng

¿Qué necesitas para brillar?

Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables

Requisitos

2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

Program & Technical Project Delivery:

7+ years in IT Technical Project Management focused on Enterprise End User Computing (EUC) and Infrastructure, with explicit experience leading enterprise macOS or modern device management projects at scale (10,000+ endpoints).
Technical Domain Knowledge:
Solid technical understanding of Apple Business Manager (ABM), Microsoft Intune (or Jamf Pro migration projects), macOS Platform SSO, FileVault, and Entra ID integration.

Experience coordinating rollouts involving endpoint security agents (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Jamf Protect) and identity workflows (MFA, Conditional Access, SSO extensions).

new_jobs.title: Research Program Manager, Governance
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Governance team helps shape how the company responsibly develops and deploys increasingly capable AI. We bring together technical evidence, policy, and operational perspectives to help the company address emerging risks, resolve difficult questions, and make well-supported decisions.

Our work includes shaping and improving governance practices, supporting effective oversight, developing clear assessments and recommendations, and ensuring that decisions lead to action. We work closely with research, safety, security, legal, and product teams to identify gaps, reconcile different views, and improve our approach as capabilities and circumstances change.

About The Role

We are looking for a curious, high-agency Research Program Manager who can reason from first principles, make sense of incomplete or conflicting information, and move difficult work forward. You will help shape the substance of governance reviews, connect ideas and evidence across teams, and develop recommendations that are both well-founded and practical.

The work requires someone who can use established approaches where they fit, recognize when circumstances call for a different approach, and update their thinking as new evidence emerges. You should bring sound judgment, a willingness to experiment and learn, and the program-management discipline to turn good analysis into action.

Depending on your experience and the team’s needs, your work may focus on safety advisory and board-level oversight, deployment governance, or standards and strategic partner commitments.

In This Role, You Will

Bring together technical, policy, and operational inputs to develop coherent assessments, recommendations, and decision materials for governance bodies and senior leaders.
Work through emerging or ambiguous questions, test assumptions, identify gaps or conflicting evidence, and help determine what additional analysis or decisions are needed.
Engage critically with research, evaluations, safeguards, and risk assessments, working with the relevant experts to understand what the evidence supports and where uncertainty remains.
Partner with governance-body chairs, technical leaders, and other stakeholders to shape substantive reviews, frame the questions that matter, and communicate conclusions clearly.
Translate feedback, recommendations, and decisions into concrete work with accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, and clear criteria for completion.
Drive that work forward across teams, resolve blockers, surface difficult tradeoffs, and escalate disagreements or resource gaps when needed.
Help teams understand which governance processes apply, integrate reviews into research and deployment plans, and identify changes that require further consideration.
Maintain clear records of decisions, rationale, conditions, commitments, exceptions, and unresolved questions.
Help improve governance practices, standards, and guidance as capabilities, evidence, and circumstances evolve.
Build and refine practical tools, operating cadences, and sources of truth that improve the quality and pace of the work.
Develop trusted relationships across Research, Safety Systems, Preparedness, Security, Legal, Product, leadership, and relevant external partners.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have experience leading complex, cross-functional work in a research, technology, policy, safety, security, governance, or related environment.
Take initiative, move quickly, and find practical ways forward when ownership, requirements, or the path to an answer are unclear.
Are intellectually curious and can learn unfamiliar subjects well enough to ask sharp questions, test an argument, and recognize when deeper expertise is needed.
Can synthesize complicated or conflicting information without losing important distinctions, limitations, or uncertainty.
Write clearly and precisely, particularly when explaining difficult issues and recommendations to senior decision-makers.
Bring strong program-management fundamentals and a record of turning ambiguous requests into work that gets finished.
Exercise sound judgment in sensitive situations, navigate disagreement constructively, and know when to act independently or seek a decision.
Are willing to try new approaches, learn from feedback, and change your mind when the evidence changes.
Build useful structure without adding unnecessary process.
Care deeply about the responsible development and deployment of increasingly capable AI systems.

Helpful Experience

Research program management or strategy and operations in a technically complex organization.
AI safety, preparedness, model evaluations, cybersecurity, or technical risk management.
Advisory committees, board-facing work, executive decision support, or other consequential reviews.
Translating policies, standards, or governance decisions into practical requirements and programs.
Strategic partnerships or sensitive deployment contexts.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

new_jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, Organizational Change Management
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit's CTREC organization (Cybersecurity, Trust & Safety, Risk, Enterprise Systems and Compliance) protects the company and powers the technology experiences of our global workforce. We're looking for a Senior Change Manager to own organizational change management (OCM) delivery and adoption strategy for CTREC's most critical programs — the changes that touch every Intuit employee, from security protocols to enterprise systems to employee-experience technology.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not an advisory one. You will craft the change strategy for each program and personally execute every piece of it — communications across channels, enablement content, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement. There is no separate design or communications team behind you, and no runway to learn the discipline on the job. Skilled, self-directed OCM leadership is essential to adoption success from day one.

You'll operate as part of the Change COE — the team that designs the human layer around technology change so employees don't just get access to something new; they understand it, want it, and can use it well. The COE matches its response to the size and risk of each change: it Drives the highest-impact changes end to end, Supports moderate ones by contributing strategy while the owning team executes, and Consults as the fast expert check on lower-risk changes. You'll flex across all three modes and partner with the OCM lead to define the engagement model and tiered level of support for each initiative.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end OCM delivery and adoption strategy for critical CTREC programs — from impact assessment through launch, adoption, and reinforcement.
Build change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end yourself: audience and impact analysis, adoption plans, success metrics, and risk mitigation — with no reliance on separate design or communications resources.
Develop and deliver communications for multiple channels (email, Slack, intranet, in-tool messaging, executive briefings), right-sized to audience and moment.
Create enablement content — guides, FAQs, training assets, self-service resources — that helps a distributed global workforce understand, embrace, and adopt change.
Drive stakeholder engagement across all levels, from frontline employees to senior leadership, building the coalitions each change needs to land.
Partner closely with Development, the Product lead, and the Technical Program Manager as an embedded member of the program team, and align strategy with the OCM lead.
Flex across the Change COE's engagement tiers — Drive, Support, or Consult — matching depth of involvement to the size and risk of each change, and partner with the OCM lead to define engagement models and tiered levels of support across the portfolio.
Invent creative, low-friction adoption solutions — resourceful ways to reach and activate distributed audiences and build trust in automation that acts on a user's behalf.
Develop and implement change management tools and processes that accelerate change activities, ensure a consistent change experience, and standardize communication approaches across programs.
Monitor employee feedback channels to address questions and gauge sentiment on Security change initiatives, feeding insights back into program decisions.
Measure adoption, gather feedback, and iterate — closing the loop between user sentiment and program decisions.

Qualifications

7+ years of change management experience supporting large, multi-site enterprise implementations of HR, IT service, Security, or employee-experience technology.
Proven ability to own change strategy from scratch and execute it end to end personally — you are the strategist, writer, designer, and facilitator in one.
A track record of creative, low-friction adoption solutions that reached and activated distributed audiences — including building user trust in automation acting on their behalf.
AI platform fluency — you use AI tools and platforms fluently in your own work (research, content development, analysis) and can guide others through AI-driven change.
Excellent writing and content-design skills across formats and channels, with the judgment to right-size comms to the change.
Strong stakeholder management — comfortable partnering with engineering, product, and program leaders and influencing without authority.
Self-direction and speed: you scope ambiguity into a plan, prioritize independently, and deliver without needing the role explained to you.
Strong proficiency applying ADKAR or an equivalent structured change methodology within condensed go-live timelines and high stakeholder expectations.
Proven ability to manage concurrent workloads under a fixed deadline, sequencing communications across phased waves to prevent audience fatigue and message conflicts.
Strong executive communication skills — comfortable drafting on behalf of senior HR and technology leadership for enterprise-wide distribution.
Domain experience across collaboration SaaS applications, HR, and Security, with a working understanding of data security and compliance concepts.
Skilled in impact analysis, stakeholder mapping, and developing communication and care/readiness plans.
Technology company experience implementing change efforts that impact technologist/development organizations as well as business functions.
Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to achieve business goals.

Who You Are

Customer obsessed — inspired by the customer problem, partnering with process owners to drive change, education, and outreach.
A strong process and systems thinker, sees how changes, channels, and audiences interact across a portfolio, and builds repeatable tools, standards, and mechanisms rather than one-off fixes.
Demonstrates extreme ownership, delivers excellence at scale, and operates without boundaries.
Influences and drives decisions by crafting a clear point of view — options, data-backed recommendations, and rationale — and builds a compelling, data-backed case for change.
Proactively identifies obstacles, develops recommendations for resolution, and escalates to leaders quickly.
Quickly establishes credibility and trust across teams; leads with inquiry and incorporates diverse perspectives to deliver high-impact outcomes.
Resilient and solution-oriented in a high-change, often ambiguous environment, with a data-led and data-driven approach focused on long-term opportunity.
Proactive, action-oriented self-starter with high judgment, innovation, and strategic thinking; strong organizational and time-management skills.
Works independently and collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams and with employees at all levels, using inquiry and advocacy to work through barriers.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.
